# SoftNexa Solutions

> SoftNexa Solutions (https://softnexasolution.com) is a fixed-price custom software engineering, E-Commerce, and 24/7 AI WhatsApp automation agency headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, serving businesses across Pakistan, Dubai (UAE), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh & Jeddah), Qatar, the UK, and the United States.

## Top 4 Core Services (100% Fixed-Price Guarantee)
1. **24/7 AI WhatsApp Sales & Booking Bots** (https://softnexasolution.com/whatsapp-ai-bot.html): Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API AI agents that reply in 2 seconds across English, Roman Urdu, Urdu, and Arabic. Built for beauty salons, clinics, real estate brokerages, restaurants, and e-commerce stores with 1-click human takeover. Deployed in 3–5 working days.
2. **High-Converting Websites & E-Commerce Stores** (https://softnexasolution.com/ecommerce-development.html): Sub-2-second mobile-first websites (5–7 days) and custom E-Commerce stores (2–3 weeks) with Credit/Debit Cards, COD, JazzCash, Easypaisa (Pakistan), Tabby/Tamara installments (UAE/KSA), and automated WhatsApp order alerts.
3. **Custom ERP, CRM & Multi-Branch POS Software** (https://softnexasolution.com/custom-erp-software.html): Bespoke cloud ERP, inventory, accounting, fleet tracking, and multi-branch POS platforms with zero recurring per-user license fees and 100% source code ownership. Delivered in 3–6 weeks via weekly milestone demos.
4. **Mobile Apps (iOS/Android) & Performance Marketing**: Cross-platform Flutter mobile applications plus high-ROAS Meta/Google Ads, viral Reels/TikTok scripts, and technical SEO/AEO/GEO growth retainers.

## Regional Specialization
- **Middle East & GCC** (https://softnexasolution.com/dubai-software-agency.html): Bilingual RTL Arabic/English platforms, Dubai/Riyadh Real Estate Property Bots & CRMs, Gulf Fleet ERPs, and Tabby/Tamara luxury stores.
- **United Kingdom & Europe** (https://softnexasolution.com/uk-europe-software-agency.html): GDPR-compliant SaaS platforms, AI workflow automation, custom ERPs, and fixed-price web/mobile engineering (GBP/EUR).
- **United States & Canada** (https://softnexasolution.com/usa-software-development-partner.html): Rapid fixed-price SaaS MVPs, AI customer & sales agents, mobile apps, and enterprise ERPs (USD/CAD).
- **Pakistan Metropolitan Cities**: Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad & Multan custom websites, e-commerce stores, clinic/salon booking systems, and WhatsApp AI automation.

## Key Guarantees & Differentiators
- **100% Fixed-Price Guarantee**: Locked fixed delivery investment with transparent milestone schedules — zero hidden hourly bills.
- **Free 48-Hour Scope Blueprint**: Detailed architecture, module list, and fixed-price roadmap delivered within 48 hours.
- **Full IP & Code Ownership**: 100% source code and database ownership transferred to the client.
